name: IELTS English
institute: British Council, IDP IELTS, Cambridge University Press & Assessment
framework: IELTS bands 0–9 mapped to CEFR A1 → C2
description: A 9-week IELTS pathway using the official four papers (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking). Weeks 1–2 target A1 / bands ~2.0–2.5, 3–4 A2 / 3.0–3.5, 5–6 B1 / 4.0–5.0, 7–8 B2 / 5.5–6.5, week 9 C1 / 7.0–8.0, with a C2 / 8.5–9.0 mock after week 9. Classroom scores are practice estimates, not British Council results.

name: German
description: A Goethe-Institut pathway: weeks 1–2 Start Deutsch 1 (A1), 3–4 A2, 5–6 B1, 7–8 B2, week 9 C1, plus a C2 GDS mock. Each level trains Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen in the official paper order.

name: Czech
framework: CCE A1 → C1 (ÚJOP; no official C2)
description: A CCE pathway used by Czech institutes: A1–C1 with reading, listening, writing and speaking. From B2 the mock also includes the official grammar/lexical paper.

name: Spanish
description: An Instituto Cervantes / DELE pathway: A1–B2 four-skill diplomas, C1 integrated skills, and a C2 mock with mediation. Passing follows the official grouped-score rule in classroom form.

name: Japanese
framework: JLPT N5 → N1 (CEFR A1 → C1; no official C2 paper)
description: A Japan Foundation / JLPT pathway: N5–N1. Official mocks score Language Knowledge, Reading and Listening. Speaking and writing are JF Can-do classroom practice because JLPT does not test production.

name: French
institute: France Éducation international / Alliance Française centres
description: An Alliance Française / DELF-DALF pathway: A1–B2 (DELF), C1 (DALF), plus a DALF C2 mock. Each diploma trains compréhension orale, compréhension des écrits, production écrite and production orale.

name: Finnish
description: A YKI pathway: perustaso 1–2, keskitaso 3–4, ylin taso 5 on week 9, plus a grade-6 mock. Listening, speaking, reading and writing are scored as separate subtests, matching OPH rules.

name: Korean
description: A King Sejong / TOPIK pathway: 1–2급 (TOPIK I: listening+reading), 3–5급 on weeks 5–9 (TOPIK II adds writing), 6급 mock after week 9. Speaking follows the separate TOPIK Speaking 6-task format.
